path.data-subject-role: Thin oceanic lithosphere bends down-right; slab top also owns shared overriding interface once. End/left cross-section cuts are schematic.
Thicker overriding continental material; actual forearc face meets slab at trench.
Overriding material base starts on slab-top at contactP; no duplicate stroke along common interfaceT-to-P.
Ocean water surface ends at actual forearc coastline; does not continue through continental rock.
Oceanic material motion toward trench/right, not measured rate or additional force.
